```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute and trigger LOW VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 15
    And the current VTI is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTI
    Then a "LOW VTI" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and trigger HIGH VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 25
    And the current VTI is 30
    When the GUI computes the VTI
    Then a "HIGH VTI" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and trigger LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 15
    And the current VTE is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Compute VTI for each breath
    Given the current VTI is 25
    When the GUI computes the VTI
    Then the VTI should be 25

  Scenario: Set VTI threshold control
    Given the VTI threshold control is enabled
    When the user sets the VTI threshold to 30
    Then the VTI threshold should be 30

  Scenario Outline: Set VTI threshold control with invalid values
    Given the VTI threshold control is enabled
    When the user sets the VTI threshold to <threshold>
    Then the VTI threshold should remain unchanged

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 20        |
      | 30        |
      | -5        |
      | 100       |
```
